dog.description_text:
Lloyd is a 3-year-old Shih Tzu mix who is as sweet as they come. He’s house-trained, crate-trained, and incredibly easy to have around. At home, he’s perfectly happy snoozing and relaxing, but once he’s out and about, he loves saying hello to everyone he meets. He’ll even pop up onto his hind legs to make sure you notice him.

Lloyd is also curious about other dogs and likes to take the initiative when greeting them. He’s friendly, calm, and just a genuinely lovely little guy who seems happy to be wherever his people are.

Registered adopters interested in Lloyd can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
